source_friction: The source foot spheres and floor leave MuJoCo geom friction unauthored: default sliding coefficient 1.0, combined by maximum, condim 3.
residual_differences: MuJoCo soft contact with default solref/solimp is not equivalent to PhysX rigid contact; the asset's authored PhysX contact offset is retained.
PhysX static and dynamic coefficients both approximate the single MuJoCo sliding coefficient.
Isaac keeps its scaled unit-sphere collider representation, sphere orientation and body decomposition; only sphere centers move.
attribution: Derived from the pinned NVIDIA GR00T-WholeBodyControl deployment model; uses existing NVIDIA/Unitree terms in README and licenses.
